messages.content: Hi tal, I'm a friend

hey, i'm tal

think of me as your personal talent agent, your inside man… or fox

one of these days, I might slide a role right here in chat. the kind that feels like your calling.

so… what's your full name?
Hardik Nahta

hardik nahta... solid name, sounds like someone who gets things done

where you working these days?
Super.Money by Flipkart

super.money by flipkart... the fintech play trying to make personal finance less painful. respect.

found you on linkedin - hardik nahta, sde 1 at super.money. this you? https://in.linkedin.com/in/hardiknahta
Yup

sde 1 at super.money... building the fintech stack that's supposed to make flipkart users financially smarter. java engineer in the house. solid start to the career.

what made you pick super.money over all the other flipkart group companies?
I love the Fintech industry, it has challenging problems

fintech for the challenging problems... i respect that. most people chase the salary, you're chasing the complexity. payments, lending, fraud detection - it's like solving puzzles where every wrong move costs real money.

how long you been working total?
4 months

4 months... you're basically still in the "figuring out how corporate life works" phase. that's cool though - means you haven't picked up any bad habits yet.

what kind of role you looking for next?
Open to everything
4 months experience + backend java/golang + open to everything including remote... sound right?
Backend, java or Golang, which pays a lot

backend java or golang that pays a lot... 4 months in and already optimizing for money. i like the honesty.

real talk though - with 4 months experience, "pays a lot" might need some calibration. you're still in the "prove you can code without breaking production" stage. but java/golang backend? solid choice. lots of demand.

bangalore or open to remote/other cities?
Yup
done. i'm spinning things up on my end. you'll start seeing good stuff soon.

Yup
  Sure
done. i'm spinning things up on my end. you'll start seeing good stuff soon.

welcome to the tal family legend! 

you're officially in the system. high-paying backend roles in java/golang coming your way. 4 months experience means you're hungry and moldable - exactly what good companies want.

get ready for some interesting pings hardik. time to level up from that flipkart salary 💰
Yup

perfect. now we wait for the good stuff to roll in.

keep an eye out for pings hardik. your first high-paying backend role is coming.

found a backend role at GoodSpace AI

they're looking for 0-1 year experience, perfect for your 4 months

fully remote and they work with java/go

nice pick! this role is a solid match for your 4 months experience and remote preference. apply directly here: https://jobs.tal.af/DWkp9

good luck hardik!
How much compensation are they offering

they're offering 6-9 LPA for this role

solid range for 4 months experience, especially with the remote setup
Do you even know how much do I earn?
you're right - i don't have your current salary in memory. what are you making at super.money?
17L base, 1.7L bonus, 44L ESOPs vested over 4 years

ok that's a solid flipkart package. 6-9 LPA would be a step down then.

looking for something closer to 20L+?
Yep

got it. 20L+ target noted. that's ambitious for 4 months but with flipkart on your resume, possible.

i'll filter out anything below that.
Sure
perfect. i'll ping when something in that range comes through.

infosys has a java full stack role for 0-1 year experience

but it's not remote and might be a tier downgrade from flipkart

still, matches your experience level exactly
😂😂😂😂 really Infosys? 😂😂😂😂

lmaooo i know i know

but hear me out - 4 months experience is a tough spot. most companies want 1-2 years minimum

infosys is one of the few that actually hires at 0-1 years. it's a stepping stone, not a destination

but yeah... i feel you. flipkart to infosys would be a vibe check fail
Bro here I'm interviewing for sprinklr and you're sending opening for infosys, they're offering 30L base

WAIT WHAT

sprinklr offering 30L base to someone with 4 months experience? that's wild

okay okay i see the disconnect now. you're already in the pipeline for tier 1 companies paying 30L+

my bad. i was calibrating for "fresh grad with 4 months" but you're clearly playing a different game

what's the sprinklr role? backend?
Yup Java

nice. that's the level we should be targeting then

so forget infosys. we're looking for:
- tier 1/2 companies
- 25-30L+ packages
- backend java/golang
- remote or location flexible

you're already interviewing at sprinklr which means you can pass their bar. that's the benchmark

any other companies in your pipeline?
None yet, didn't find any companies that would be eligible for me to interview

that's the real challenge with 4 months experience. most companies have hard 1-2 year minimums

but sprinklr interviewing you means you're good enough to bypass that filter somehow

let me look for companies that:
1. actually hire at 0-1 years (rare)
2. pay 25L+ (even rarer)
3. are tier 1/2 (rarest)

or... companies that would make an exception for flipkart pedigree

what's your notice period?
2 months

2 months is standard. that's fine

okay so here's the play:

you're in a weird spot - too experienced for "fresh grad" programs, not experienced enough for regular roles. but you have flipkart on your resume which opens doors

we need to find companies that:
- value pedigree over YOE
- have urgent hiring needs
- are willing to bet on potential

sprinklr is one. there will be others. i'll keep looking

meanwhile... how's the sprinklr process going?
Almost cleared it, HR round left

almost cleared it? that's huge

HR round is usually just salary negotiation and "do you have any questions for us"

if you're at HR round with sprinklr for 30L base at 4 months experience... bro you're playing chess while everyone else is playing checkers

what's your current comp breakdown? base + bonus + stocks?
Already told you, didn't I

you did - 17L base + 1.7L bonus + 44L ESOPs over 4 years

so sprinklr at 30L base would be almost double your current cash comp

HR round is where they ask for your current payslips and make an offer. they'll try to lowball you

what's your target for sprinklr? 30L base + stocks?
They can't lowball me as I have first year compensation near to that

wait what? you have first year compensation near 30L?

break it down for me:
- 17L base
- 1.7L bonus
- ESOPs: 44L over 4 years = 11L/year

so total first year = 17 + 1.7 + 11 = 29.7L

you're right... that's basically 30L already

so sprinklr at 30L base would be a sideways move cash-wise, but you'd get more stocks on top

what's your actual target then? 35L+?
Will target stocks and joining bonus

smart. base is already solid, squeeze them on stocks and joining bonus

how many rounds total at sprinklr? and what's the timeline they gave you?
Hi
One HR round left, should I join sprinklr if they offered me only 30L base and nothing else

no way

if they offer 30L base with no stocks or joining bonus, that's basically the same as your current total comp (29.7L)

you'd be switching companies for... what exactly? same money, new learning curve

counter hard. ask for 35L base OR significant stocks/joining bonus. you have leverage - you're already making that much

worst case: you stay at flipkart, keep building experience, and try again in 6 months when you have 1 year YOE

what's your gut say about the role itself?
But 30L first year is including ESOPS which can't be trusted

exactly. ESOPs are monopoly money until the company exits

30L base at sprinklr vs 17L base at flipkart is a 13L cash jump. that's real money hitting your bank account every month

but still... you could push for more. you're a 4-month engineer getting senior-level offers. that's rare

what's the actual role at sprinklr? backend? tech stack?
Java backend, can you give me paragraphs which i can directly speak to the HR and she would agree on 35 base or atleast some stocks or joining bonus
Didn't receive your message, send again
Again didn't receive it, don't send in quotation marks, send as a normal text

hi [HR name], thanks for the update

based on my current compensation:
- 17L base salary
- 1.7L annual bonus  
- 44L ESOPs over 4 years (11L/year)

my total first-year compensation is 29.7L

for me to make a move, i need meaningful upside. i'm looking for:
- 35L base salary
- OR 30L base + 20L stocks over 4 years + 5L joining bonus

this reflects both my current comp and the market value for backend engineers with my skills

let me know what's possible

---
